runtime: Kotlin / Jetpack Compose; no Ionic or Cordova runtime

environment.device: owned Pixel 8 API 36 Google APIs emulator (AVD tw_api36_capture)

build_type: debug; ads off for the capture: the test APK's NoAdsPlatform replaces the consent and Ads SDK platform (capture.sh --no-ads), so no consent request, SDK start or ad load happens; the app APK is the ordinary debug build

safety.product_push: intercepted by TestTodayWeatherApp; no token argument
safety.analytics: nothing sent: the 2026-11-24 captures use the test application's SilentAnalyticsSdk (asserted at each capture); earlier captures kept analytics off, asserted at each capture
safety.alarms: edited then discarded; stored push state asserted unchanged
safety.share: Android text chooser opened and canceled; no recipient
safety.data: live weather/geocode/nation/Places reads; seeded saved places for later sections
safety.sdk_network: Google Places and Firebase installation/configuration/messaging may contact their services; no consent (UMP) request and no Ads SDK start (asserted at each capture)
safety.cleanup: both task APKs removed on exit; runner fails offline if removal cannot be verified

processing: RGB, Lanczos 1080x2400 -> 720x1600, 256-color MEDIANCUT without dithering; no screen content replaced or redrawn
limitations: API36 emulator captures; not a release APK or physical-device certification
No actual notification delivery, analytics opt-in, or share recipient exercised
The selected photo and SDK artwork retain their original third-party rights
Live values, forecasts, available warning bulletins and Android dialogs vary
Captured without ads; the released app shows native ad cards (see forecast-ads)
